appearance.scope: Continuous original paving stone205 only. Native paving reception remains unproved; CPU reception and main-upper normal-route reflected-hit execution are separate demonstrated paths.
appearance.controls: Original upper main/ramp/southern and lower main fixed-view CPU PBR-off, PBR-on/GI-off, sky-only and GI-on controls inspected. Continuous paving response, no fixed new hard material-lighting boundary. Separate advancing-simulation southern CPU overcast/dusk, TAA/FSR/MSAA settled controls and two bounces inspected; dusk PBR-off/GI-off/on geometry aligns.
appearance.duskBandIsolation: A sharp L-shaped dark band in CPU dusk PBR-on/GI-off/on triggered a hold. Same-byte fresh advancing-simulation isolation shows it disappears with RT sunlight shadows off, returns with shadows restored, and moves under15:00/17:30/18:00 sun times. It is an existing RT-sun-shadow response, not a fixed source-face material seam or GI patch. An elevated railing/top-bar occluder is consistent with the original geometry, but exact occluder identity is not independently traced. Shadows are restored on; no source, renderer, temporal logic, gate or ray budget workaround is used.
appearance.limits: Selected direct developer standing views, not physical traversal, Steam or all4-placement acceptance. Spatial-only MSAA grain and settled captures are not clean MSAA equivalence/in-motion acceptance. Family footprints are not source-specific receiving masks. No new eligible205 hit observed in other3 bounded views is not all-world zero. Batch25 frozen post-AA mismatch remains unresolved and is not fixed or broadly recertified here. method: Original Nogova R01WarCry through existing direct developer harness, copied profile, --nosound, synchronization validation. Four original object transforms queried without moving objects. Selected developer standing cameras1.8m above inspected original upper/lower stone floors, not terrain below the quay. Not physical traversal, Steam or mission completion. Explicit triSetSimTime0 before each frozen action. Auto/TAA100%, one bounce, RT sun/cloud shadows, AO/water/volumetrics off for costs. Warm10 then Off/On/On/Off settle4/sample6 at1920x1080 and2560x1440. No build/heavy census/other game during sampling.
batchAcceptance: Continuous original stone205 only, all verified source users. Independent gates unchanged. Rusted-door atlas, green vertical seawall finish, mixed corroded shed and utility caps remain original. Whole source mesh area includes deep/buried wall geometry, not exposed pavement coverage.
visualLimits: Five physical source-unknown image reviews among7 decoded references. Alpha railing/far composite are not additional optical adoptions. Separate native/CPU family-frame samples and actual eligible reflected-hit observations, not source-specific receiver masks or world distributions. Spatial-only MSAA grain/settled captures are not clean MSAA equivalence or physical in-motion acceptance. Water controls do not invent wet stone maps or model-bottom transmission.

buildArtifacts.identityLimit: Public base4e3520f plus batch26 material data/tests before documentation commit. Loaded hashes, not sourceHEAD, identify executions. Original assets, v3, existing PBR/regions, GL33, private DLSS, shaders/transport/filter/ray budgets and safety functions unchanged.
